steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Come on, hang in there... We need to make even more roses, enough to fill this garden...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Cough, cough! But... but it seems like, there's not enough to make more roses...
In the empty garden, scattered roses sway in the wind.
The rich crimson seems to flow, the petals brushing against the plaster arch, leaving mottled red marks. The strokes look like the lonely marks made by a girl waiting for her parents to return.
But no one stays for this beautiful rose garden.
What beautiful roses you have in your garden! Did you grow them all by yourself?
The blue-haired girl suddenly emerges in the garden, her turquoise hair highlighting the blood-red hue of the roses.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Yes... I've nurtured these roses with love. They're reserved for the most important person.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: But I... I've run out of love... Can you help me? I want to fill the entire garden with roses. Do you have enough love inside you?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: I wanted to ask those little fish for help, but they don't understand love and can't become roses. What about you... Can you?
Victoria grabs L.L.'s wrist eagerly, her tear-filled eyes as transparent and endearing as the crystal roses blooming in the garden.
Just like a child's gaze.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hmm, I know what you want. Elysiland can certainly satisfy you. Let's give it a try!
The blue-haired girl snaps her fingers, conjuring up a few buckets of bright red liquid before Victoria. She gropes in the liquid for a moment only to stain her hands red.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: No... This won't work... Why?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Why hasn't my wish come true? Can't Elysiland grant all wishes?
Confused and disappointed, the girl withdraws her hands and resumes straining herself. Soon, another rose blooms out of her wrist, but its color is dull and its stem is fragile.
Red particles detach from Victoria's body, and L.L. is keenly aware of her weakening mental strength. She can no longer support the growth of another blood-red rose, yet she keeps trying stubbornly.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Hey, don't lose faith in Elysiland yet!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I think... maybe we haven't gotten the correct material. The most important material should be the "love" you've mentioned, right?
Victoria's doubtful attitude makes L.L. feel indignant.
She cuts her own wrist swiftly, and after the spattering particles fade, the blood beads drip onto the garden lawn like a broken string of pearls.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Of course, the most intense form of love here is mine!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I love this island and everyone here. I hope you can all be bathed in happiness, joy, and satisfaction all the time!
Thick liquid keeps falling next to Victoria, turning into beautiful flowers upon contact.
L.L. forces herself to stand, her face growing paler as her excitement intensifies.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Go ahead, use this to build the world you desire and fulfill your wishes!
L.L. embraces Victoria, supporting herself with Victoria's body while murmuring into her ear.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Roses... Great. I can use it to make roses...!

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: My rose garden can finally be filled with roses... My wish will come true...
Victoria reaches out in astonishment to touch the flower bed. Under her red-stained palms, roses twist and grow vibrantly, filling the gaps in the rose garden.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Bloom, bloom, little rose. Your petals will make a road. The departed one awaits, when the roses bloom, 'tis the return day...
As the rose garden gradually takes shape, L.L.'s face slowly turns pale. But she doesn't care, and even watches the beautiful yet morbid scene before her excitedly.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: What a wonderful wish. What a wonderful view.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Who is this person worth risking your life for to create such a garden?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Well, because by the time the world's largest rose garden is filled with roses of love, Daddy will come back!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Daddy?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You're creating this rose garden to bring your father back?
L.L. widens her eyes at Victoria's response, but her expression turns cold.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: What a little fool! You don't even know you've been lied to! Let me tell you...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: As soon as they realize you're a burden, they'll disappear from your life and never come back.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: What you believe in is just a lie to distract you, so you won't act up...

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: But Daddy's made a promise. He's never lied to me.
The girl's innocent eyes, pure expression, and complete trust ignite a burst of anger in L.L.'s heart. She leaves a hesitant sentence before turning away.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Well... maybe... what you have is a different kind of love? Then let me see if this miracle will really happen...
Victoria stands dazedly, looking lost, as she watches L.L. leave.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Do you also have matters to tend to in the other world?

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Then... where can I find the remaining roses? Will Daddy... still come back?
The rose in her hand slowly melts and returns to its original form of blood, dripping through her fingers onto the stone slab, like tears accumulating in the heart.
The roses in the entire garden wither and melt. The girl watches the garden fall back into desolation, her expression blank.
Suddenly, she notices the crimson liquid flowing in one direction, as if forming a petal-paved path. At the end of the path stands a familiar figure.
Is that her father? No... it's not.
That gray figure's mere presence seems to soothe her emotions, making her feel at ease.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Chief?
The rose in Victoria's hand blooms again. She reaches out to the figure, welcoming the red thorns growing and spreading toward her.
These are the thorns that can tightly connect the two and will bloom with gorgeous roses.

steps.speaker: Victoria
steps.content: Are you here to pick me up?
She stands up and walks out of the rose garden.
The roses behind her wilt and turn to dust rapidly, but in her right hand, a blood-red rose still blooms amid the shackles glowing with crimson light.
